meta.desc: Homepage of the clothing designer, 100% made in Quebec, designed by TIM students with designs produced by artificial intelligence, and made with 100% natural and organic fibres.

acceuil.amorceAchat: Teeshirts, hoodies, and caps made in Quebec 💯
acceuil.amorceH4: /** with a little help from DALL-E 😉 **/
acceuil.para1: Today, the T-shirt is an essential garment in everyone's wardrobe. And in an era where environmental issues are more important than ever, we prefer T-shirts made in Quebec in order to reduce environmental impact and highlight local craftsmanship.
acceuil.para2: V-neck, crew neck, loose or fitted T-shirts, with short or long sleeves for those who feel the cold, plain or patterned to add style to an outfit... The T-shirt is available in a variety of colours, styles, and patterns.
